title: The words verdict counts tags and text by a rule the platform does not use
body:
## Summary
fixtureAlbum's wordsVerdict and WordsData.tagChars count tags as tags.join(',') and title/description by UTF-16 length; the platform (lib/publish/youtube.ts snippetProblem) counts code points, UTF-8 bytes and quotes around a spaced tag, and the words editor now does too.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureAlbum.ts:57 `tagChars = tags.join(',').length`, :61-63 `.length` against WORDS_LIMITS; packages/domain/src/partView.album.ts:25 documents tagChars as 'as the platform counts them (joined with commas)'. lib/publish/youtube.ts:189 and packages/ui/src/components/floor/schedule.ts:116 carry the quote rule, each its own copy. So the part's verdict can read ready over words the uploader refuses (a 3000-'é' description: verdict ready, upload 'description exceeds 5000 bytes') and blocked/ready at a different tag count than the editor's counter shows. Fixed looks like one exported counter in @gt/domain/partView.album.ts (title code points, description bytes, tags with quotes) read by the verdict, the view's tagChars, Words.tsx's COUNT, schedule.ts and youtube.ts.

## Flow
- a words part with tags ['lo fi','rain'] -> verdict counts 10, the editor and YouTube 12
- a description of 3000 accented letters -> verdict ready, editor 6000/5000 over, upload refused
- fix: hoist the platform counter into partView.album.ts, use it at the five sites

## Expected impact
The operator's words verdict agrees with the counter beside the field and with the upload. Could break: parts-finish cases pinning the old verdict text.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one tag/text count rule for verdict, editor and uploader
Before: 3 rules across 5 sites (join(',') in fixtureAlbum; quote rule in youtube.ts, schedule.ts, Words.tsx; UTF-16 length in the verdict)
After: 1 rule, 1 site, 5 readers (predicted)
Method: simulation - out of scope: fixtureAlbum.ts belongs to part-port-fixtures (running concurrently), partView.album.ts to domain-parts-projects-slots
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tests/next-server/parts-finish.test.ts cases: a words part with tags ['lo fi','rain'] reports 12 in tagChars and the verdict; a 3000-'é' description is blocked over-limit

title: A brief or words field blurred while a write is in flight is dropped silently
body:
## Summary
AdsBrief's BriefField and Words' Counted commit on blur through send; while another write is in flight the island declines the op, and the field keeps showing the typed text as if it were saved.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/AdsBrief.tsx:48-51 and app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Words.tsx Counted `done` call onCommit/commit on blur; app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/PartEditor.tsx `write` returns at `if (inflight.current) return;` with no error. The draft stays (base === value), so nothing marks it unsaved; it is only re-sent if the operator focuses and blurs that field again. Tabbing through the brief's seven fields is exactly the path: blur field 1 sends, blur field 2 lands inside field 1's round trip. Fixed looks like: a field whose commit was declined holds a pending mark and re-commits when busy falls (or the island queues field commits by field key).

## Flow
- type product, Tab, type audience, Tab (inside the first round trip)
- -> audience's set-brief is declined by the island; the field shows the text, the record does not have it
- fix: Counted/BriefField take busy, keep `pending` when a blur lands busy, commit on the busy->idle edge

## Expected impact
An operator tabbing through the brief or the words loses the second field's edit with no sign. Could break: a double commit if the edge fires twice.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - no edit silently dropped
Before: 2 field components drop a blur that lands in flight (reproducible in the harness: busy=true, blur -> 0 ops, draft shown)
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the fix is a design choice (re-commit vs queue) across two files; the round built the instrument shape but not the fix
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tests/next-server/part-editor-writing.test.ts fields(): render Counted/BriefField with busy=true, blur with a draft, flip busy=false, assert one op sent with the draft

title: The legend offers pick on the item that is already picked, and the key declines
body:
## Summary
ScenariosEditor and AdsBriefEditor hand the workspace the `item` fact whenever an item is selected, so the legend draws A 'adopt · pick' / ⏎ 'open · pick' over the picked scenario or idea, where the key is declined and no pick button is drawn.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Scenarios.tsx:45 `pick` returns false when sc.id === d.picked, :58 facts ['item'] regardless; :62 the pick Button is hidden for the picked one. app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/AdsBrief.tsx:76 `open` declines on idea.id === d.picked, :79 facts ['item']. packages/ui/src/keymap/bindings.ts:189,193 gate both rows on `item`, which also gates Esc deselect, so the fix needs a separate fact (e.g. `unpicked`) on those rows - a bindings change in @gt/ui.

## Flow
- select the picked scenario -> legend shows A adopt · pick -> press A -> declined
- fix: bindings rows 189/193 `when: "pickable"`, editors add the fact when the item is not the picked one

## Expected impact
The legend stops offering a key that does nothing. Could break: other editors on part.script/part.research that rely on `item` for A/⏎ (Document adopt toggles, Notebook open focuses).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - legend rows match live keys
Before: 2 editors draw a dead pick row for the picked item
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the binding lives in packages/ui keymap (out of scope); part-editor-media.test.ts legend() compares registered verbs, not declines, so it needs a 'press each drawn row' extension
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: legend() from part-editor-media.test.ts extended to press each drawn row's handler and require it not to return false
drain_note: needs a new keymap fact in 3 unnamed editors; M-L

title: Two write controls that are not Buttons stay live while a write is in flight
body:
## Summary
The beat board's variant tiles (raw <button> whose click picks) and the beat document's note <select> (onChange sends note-add) send ops while busy; the island drops them without a word.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Beats.tsx variant button onClick `(setSlotSel, setSel, pick(sl, v.id))`; app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx Usage <select onChange> sends note-add. The Button sweep (fc93133c) covered Button only. A tile's click also selects, so it cannot simply be disabled: the pick half needs the busy guard and an aria-disabled-like mark; a native select's `disabled` leaves the tab order, which the kit's Button convention refuses.

## Flow
- busy -> click a variant tile -> selection moves, pick op dropped
- busy -> choose a note kind -> note op dropped, select resets to 'note'
- fix: guard the pick and the note-add on busy, mark both aria-disabled while busy

## Expected impact
The last two silent drops on these editors go. Could break: selection on a tile while busy if the guard is too wide.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every write control disarms while busy
Before: 2 control families live while busy (1 per variant tile, 1 per usage row)
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - needs a design call on tile select-vs-pick and native select disablement; the instrument is the round's buttons() walker extended to raw onClick/onChange controls
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: tests/next-server/part-editor-writing.test.ts buttons() walker extended to raw <button onClick> and <select onChange> that call send; count live while busy (before 2 families, after 0)
